Soluble 1 in 2 of water, 1 in 7 of alcohol, and 1 in 7000 of chloroform; practi- cally insoluble in absolute ether. pH of a 10% solution in water is between 10.0 and 11.2. Store in airtight containers. Profile Secbutabarbital is a barbiturate with general properties similar to those of amobarbital (p.961).
